source.title: Something New
source.description:
I think we need to learn more about this new plague. This seems to be targeted at... killing the undead and the living? The undead are naturally immune to the plague of undeath, being of said plague to begin with. If what I suspect is true, this might be something new and terrible.

I am loathe to subject the undead here to more torment, but we must learn more before we return to Light's Hope.
source.objective: Use the New Plague Samples on weakened Cannibal Ghouls, Stitched Horrors, Cursed Mages, Scourge Soldiers and Scourge Warders found throughout Plaguewood and observe the effects.
source.progress:
Being this close to Stratholme is unsettling to me after...

<Leonid Barthalomew the Revered pauses while looking in the direction of Stratholme and you notice that his hand starts to tremble slightly.>

...nevermind, it's nothing.

Let's conclude our business here quickly, <name>.
source.completion:
The effect these plagues have on the undead are profound and terrifying. If these were to be turned against the forsaken in the ruins of Lordaeron, well, it could  be catastrophic.

There's one other test we need to perform.
